description: Unit test class for the AllergyValidator in the OpenMRS project, validating allergy data correctness and duplicate detection.

classes.name: AllergyValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for the AllergyValidator class, ensuring validation rules are enforced for allergies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailForANullValue
methods.description: Tests that validating a null allergy object throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if the patient field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAllergenIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if the allergen field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIdAllergenTypeIsNull
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if the allergen's type is not specified.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfCodedAndNonCodedAllergenAreNull
methods.description: Validates that either a coded or non-coded allergen must be provided.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNonCodedAllergenIsNullAndAllergenIsSetToOtherNonCoded
methods.description: Ensures that if allergen is non-coded, its value must be non-empty.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectADuplicateAllergen
methods.description: Tests rejection of duplicate allergen entries for the same patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectADuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests rejection of duplicate non-coded allergen entries for the same patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForAValidAllergy
methods.description: Ensures a valid allergy passes validation with no errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectNumericReactionValue
methods.description: Tests that reaction values that are purely numeric are invalid.
